info.title: Scouting Tenant Club API
info.description: API for Club Tenant managing Team Roster, Players, Matches, Scouting Progress, Subscriptions, Packages, and Invoices.

servers.description: Local Development Server (Use 'x-subdomain' header for tenant routes)

SuperAdminAuth.description: Super Admin JWT token returned from POST /api/auth/login

TenantAuth.description: Tenant JWT token returned from POST /api/tenant/auth/login

TenantSubdomain.name: x-subdomain
TenantSubdomain.description: Subdomain of the club (e.g. 'ahly'). Required for /api/tenant/* routes when developing on localhost.

BadRequest.description: Validation error or invalid request body

get.description: Checks server status, uptime, and database connectivity

post.description: Authenticates club admin, coach, or viewer against this club's isolated database.

get.description: Returns everything the tenant dashboard needs on initial load: club profile, days left in subscription, database name, settings, and entity counts.

get.summary: Browse Available Packages to Buy / Renew
get.description: Returns all active subscription packages with calculated savings, durations, and whether the package is the club's current active plan.
Returns active payment methods where clubs can transfer subscription fees (e.g. InstaPay address, Vodafone Cash, Bank Account).
Returns all past and current package orders made by this club, with approval status and pricing snapshots.

post.description: Instantly creates a pending order for this club (without needing separate cart steps). Also logs the purchase in the club's cart collection for synchronization.

example.message: Package purchased successfully. Your order is pending super admin approval.

get.description: Returns structured invoice data for this club's order. Pass `?format=html` to get printable HTML.

200.description: Clean HTML invoice ready for print or saving as PDF

example.message: Order created and sent to the super admin for review

delete.description: Cannot delete team if it contains players or matches

post.description: Supports two formats: either our team vs external opponent (`team_id` + `opponent_name`) OR two internal teams (`team1_id` + `team2_id`).

post.summary: Record Player Action Event in Match
post.description: Registers an action event for a player. Automatically verifies that the action belongs to the game and that the player's team participated in this match.
